tldr: The field-tier contribution remains a complete denominator audit for primitive coprime reduced rational causal certificates supported on three covariance variables. The rigidity mechanism is now proved in every matrix dimension on the corank-one branch: adjugate translation needs no homogeneity, and homogeneity plus positive-gradient cone order forces a fixed global kernel line and compression whenever the gradient has rank \(d-1\) somewhere in the positive-definite cone. This closes Tamano's mixed \(\operatorname{Sym}_3\) branch without degree or nonresonance restrictions and isolates the higher-dimensional open problem to generic rank at most \(d-2\), where the adjugate vanishes. The resulting \(\operatorname{Sym}_3\) classification and terminating rational recognizer decide exactly when a reduced half-trek or related certificate has one nested flag denominator; no full higher-dimensional converse or new coverage theorem is claimed.
